PROFILE::udp
       Returns the value of a UDP profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::udp ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned UDP profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned UDP profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.
